caption: The drawing features a wooden bowl positioned centrally, depicted in a realistic, colored style with visible woodgrain patterns in shades of brown and light tan. The bowl has a rectangular shape with rounded corners, flaring slightly outward, and includes a small handle or protrusion at one end. The central colored rendering is surrounded by thin, light blue or gray schematic line drawings that outline geometric shapes related to the bowl’s form; one is located above and another below the main bowl illustration, each showing the bowl from different perspectives (top and side views). The background is an off-white or beige color, with scattered areas of light brown stains or marks, giving it an aged or used appearance. The line drawings are enclosed within faint rectangular borders, and the composition is symmetrical along the vertical axis.
